pairs.notes: The original is garbled, so I only report the clear shifts. I left out these uncertain ones: 'fruit of the evening meal' -> 'dusk' (time), 'star' -> 'spark', and 'night end drew closer' -> 'Night slipped in' (end of night vs arrival of night). 'Only' is kept.

pairs.notes: The weekday names are in both texts. I left out 'Tuesdays through Fridays' -> 'Tuesdays between Fridays' (garbled range, intent seems kept), 'new schedule' -> 'this schedule', and 'there will no set policy' -> 'there does no set guideline' (the 'no' is kept, so no flip).

'no moment feels less significant or important' -> 'no instant feels less minor or crucial': 'significant' was replaced by its antonym 'minor' under the same 'less', which literally reverses that part
pairs.notes: Negation is false because no negation was lost or added; the reversal comes from an antonym swap, so I put it in 'other'. 'casual lunch trade' -> 'simple lunch deal', 'plush' -> 'soft' and 'ethos' -> 'tradition' are synonym-level.

other: 'dark ceilings' -> 'shades walls': ceilings became walls and 'dark' is lost; 'white paint' -> 'white layer' also loses the paint

'there wasn't anything left to be done but retrieve the parcel' -> 'there wasn't nothing remaining to be attempt the package': the exclusive 'nothing but retrieve' is gone and 'retrieve' became 'attempt'
pairs.notes: Negation flip left false: 'wasn't nothing' is a double negative, which read literally says something remained, but the original also says one thing (retrieving) remained, so I could not call the polarity reversed. I did not list 'nothing but' as a quantifier and put it in 'other'. 'tucked' -> 'folded' and 'seal' -> 'stamp' are close enough to leave out.

Original is Italian, rewrite is English. 'Raramente' -> 'seldom', 'per sempre' -> 'forever' and 'infinita' -> 'boundless' keep their strength. 'iconicità' -> 'fame' and 'costante' -> 'relentless' are slight shifts that I treated as synonyms.
